criteria.statement: Read-only synchronous tools are executed inline and returned as succeeded AssistantToolObservation values.
Allowed async mutation tools are dispatched once, persisted as agent_loop waiting_async with receipt metadata, and return without blocking for terminal results.
Runtime resume converts terminal downstream success/failure events into normalized observations using the receipt correlation metadata.
Relay close or missing observer/receipt metadata fails closed by marking the loop and session blocked, not by losing the pending work.
Permission ask creates an AssistantDeferredAction and awaiting_approval session state without executing the tool; deny returns a denied observation without execution.
Startup recovery resumes agent_loop waiting_async sessions from receipt metadata.
